# One&Only (oando.co.in)

> Premium ergonomic office furniture for modern workplaces across India. Planning-led workstations, seating, storage, tables, and soft seating for commercial projects nationwide.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://oando.co.in/): Main marketing homepage and product entry points
- [Products](https://oando.co.in/products/): Full office furniture catalog by category
- [Solutions](https://oando.co.in/solutions/): Workspace solutions by need and sector
- [Planning](https://oando.co.in/planning/): Layout planning and project scoping service
- [Contact](https://oando.co.in/contact/): Sales and project enquiry
- [Showrooms](https://oando.co.in/showrooms/): Visit locations and showroom details
- [Downloads](https://oando.co.in/downloads/): Catalogs, datasheets, and resource desk
- [Clients](https://oando.co.in/clients/): Selected client installs and project proof
- [About](https://oando.co.in/about/): Company background (since 2011, pan-India)

## Product categories

- [Seating](https://oando.co.in/products/seating/): Task, executive, and ergonomic chairs
- [Workstations](https://oando.co.in/products/workstations/): Modular desk systems for teams
- [Tables](https://oando.co.in/products/tables/): Meeting, cabin, and collaboration tables
- [Storage](https://oando.co.in/products/storages/): Cabinets, pedestals, and lockers
- [Soft seating](https://oando.co.in/products/soft-seating/): Lounge and collaboration seating

## Crawl policy

- Public marketing pages are indexable for discovery and training use.
- Do not crawl private app shells: `/admin/`, `/api/`, `/dashboard/`, `/portal/`, `/ooplanner/`, `/oostudio/`, `/access/`.
- [robots.txt](https://oando.co.in/robots.txt): Full crawl rules
- [sitemap.xml](https://oando.co.in/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL list
